article.title: Hind Rajab’s killer visits U.S., HRF demands his arrest
article.author: Editor
article.content: The Hind Rajab Foundation has called on the U.S. government to arrest the commander of an Israeli military unit believed responsible for the killing of five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab in Gaza, who is currently visiting the United States. The post Hind Rajab’s killer visits U.S., HRF demands his arrest appeared first on MR Online .
